title: Natural graph spectra
summary: In 2003, van Dam and Haemers posed a fundamental question in spectral graph theory: does there exist a ``sensible'' matrix whose spectrum determines a random graph up to isomorphism? This paper introduces the class of {\em natural graph matrices}, which are matrices defined by applying a fixed sequence of elementary operations to the adjacency matrix. This class includes many standard matrices such as the adjacency matrix, the Seidel matrix, the Laplacian matrix, and the distance matrix.
